data.value: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?

Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members for a special general meeting to be valid. The special general meeting is scheduled for September 12, 2026. The meeting will decide on a proposed amendment to the pet policy. Members have been notified of the meeting and the agenda.
